rpo.andospack.title: ando's pack config
rpo.andospack.pinnedTorches.tooltip: Pins torches straight to the wall.
rpo.andospack.spruceTrapDoorFix.tooltip: Fixes the spruce trapdoor texture when tiled
rpo.andospack.adjustedLanternHold.toolti: Adjust the lantern to look like its being held from above.
rpo.andospack.mannequinArmourStand.toolt: Changes the armour stand to a player-sized mannequin.
rpo.andospack.connectedCutSandstone.tool: Connects cut sandstone and red sandstone using the Continuity mod.
rpo.andospack.vanillaXaerosWorldMapGUI.t: Replaces the world map icons with more vanilla-friendly textures.
rpo.andospack.arrowSprites.tooltip: Replaces the 3D arrow projectile entity with the 2D sprite.
rpo.andospack.arrowSpritesWeapons.toolti: Replaces the arrow in the vanilla weapon texture with the 2D sprite.
rpo.andospack.tridentSprite.tooltip: Replaces trident textures and entity more aligned with the 2D sprite.
rpo.andospack.andosite.tooltip: Replaces andesite and polishes andesite textures with andosite and polished andosite.
rpo.andospack.goldenCarrotHungerBar.tool: Replaces the hunger bar icons with golden carrots.
rpo.andospack.maceAccurate3D.tooltip: Makes the Mace accurate to the heavy core and breeze rod items.
